title: Order totals
statementMd:
Compute the total value of each order (quantity times unit price summed over its lines), rounded to 2 decimals. Show order id and total.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `total`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT oi.order_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.order_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
